entry_points.text: Unlink removes name relative to dir descriptor, needing normal last element with write hold and stale retry; VFS deletes non-dir after checks with delegation, detach, notifications; auth checks existence, identity, permissions, protections, sticky, dir expectations, liveness, silly-rename.

User-path open converts string at cwd and delegates; kernel-name open normalizes into intents before worker; getcwd samples root/cwd, renders, annotates unreachable, validates and copies; early init registers coredump sysctls and prepares DAX wait array.
DAX callers are trunc/punch for delete, writeback for flush, faults for insert/hole load and layout break around ops needing no active mappings such as unshare.

exports.text: Parent lookup returns parent path and final component with optimistic then blocking walk and stale retry; dirop holds parent lock until release drops child; mountpoint checks flag then scans namespace mounts under shared protection.
Open construction masks flags, restricts path-only subset, clears mode unless creating, validates resolve controls and derives access with intent and scoping; plus lexical scope for init fs.

Core driver snapshots limits, screens eligibility, escalates creds with taint handling, rendezvouses threads then runs file/pipe/socket dump; pipe guards recursion/overload and requires helper output; safety warns on privileged relative pattern.

Path helpers render backward against supplied or absolute root, annotating removed entries; dump snapshot records bounds/flags/sizes/offsets/refs, resolves header placeholder, accumulates bytes and optionally orders by size.

DAX provides folio lock/unlock, offset lock with sentinel for absent/zero/empty, busy scan after unmap, layout break waiting then deleting, single/range delete, sync invalidate, range writeback, file unshare and interval helpers.

hazards.text: Invalid identity fails overflow; notify warns on negative; piped dump with no output reports disabled; privileged relative pattern warns; getcwd can fail on alloc, unlinked, overlong, small buffer or fault, annotating unreachable.

Conflict and internal entries need revalidation after wait, smaller order means retry; long walks pause, release lock and reschedule; unexpected states warn once including non-value storage, missing trunc entry, dirty tag and non-page blocksize.

Error and flag facts: EISDIR ENOTDIR ENOENT EPERM EBUSY EOVERFLOW EINVAL EAGAIN ESTALE ECHILD; O_PATH narrow subset with CREAT TMPFILE, DIRECTORY NOFOLLOW EMPTYPATH TRUNC APPEND, LOOKUP DIRECTORY FOLLOW EMPTY NO_XDEV NO_SYMLINKS BENEATH IN_ROOT CACHED REVAL RCU, MAY WRITE EXEC APPEND with masking.

invariants.text: Unlink needs normal trailing; checks liveness, identity, parent rights, protections, sticky, dir expectations, NFS rename; success marks non-mountable, detaches, notifies; silly-renamed unlink only; swap/mount/root/dead fail.

Parent tries optimistic, falls back blocking, revalidates on stale, copies name/type and audits; open rejects unknown bits, conflicting scoping, bad dir/create/tmpfile combos and cached with trunc/create; path-only narrows, clears access, suppresses intent; file-only carried internally; access maps to read/write.

Dump needs formatter and dumpable state; cleanup closes, releases pipe accounting, frees name; socket needs init ns, absolute path, length bound, no traversal; pattern preserves old, rejects bad socket; pipe aborts on recursion, caps concurrency; ranges filtered, header placeholder, ordered by size.

Unlinked gets annotation and getcwd annotates unreachable; DAX wait hashes cache with huge-aligned index; order maps huge to PMD else zero with placeholder size zero; association and folio release manage shared/exclusive lifecycle with split on release.

Acquire prefers unlocked, fallback on conflict, IO failure on non-value, else locks/installs with retry; insert keeps existing normal; invalidate/clear manage detachment; writeback protects/flushes; direct resolves offset; holes install zero; unshare copies; sync needs write+sync+dirty; COW copies page.

locks.text: Dirop holds parent lock until release; unlink holds target lock across checks, auth, delegation and removal; non-mountable under dentry spinlock; mountpoint holds shared namespace; snapshot holds address write lock killably then releases before user inspection.
Dentry path walks under RCU with sequence protection, restarting on retry; root/cwd sampled with sequence retry without exclusive lock; deleted-name needs no dir lock.

Page-tree IRQ lock guards loads/stores/marks, dropped before sleep, unmap, flush/rmap and reschedule; entry lookup serializes on cache spin, waiters drop protection while sleeping then revalidate; lock lookup holds RCU but releases while waiting; direct/unshare hold DAX read lock; writeback holds interval-map read lock.

state_machines.text: Unlink flows parent resolve, mount write hold, child lookup, auth, removal, delegation wait with inner retry, write/path release and outer stale retry; open pipeline normalizes flags, validates mode, checks conflicts, derives access, selects intent and applies scoping.

Core destination selects file/pipe/socket plus request, honors mask for reject/generation/notification/sync; file dump checks interruption, snapshots, brackets writer, pads skip, frees refs; iteration yields mappables then gate once.

Index moves absent to locked empty, to present, to dirty/towrite, to clean, to detached; break loops scan/wait while busy, deletes after quiet; idle wait blocks on predicate; wake is single versus broadcast with order from huge bit.

structs.text: Open uses user and kernel descriptors; snapshot holds start/end, flags, length, offset, file ref with count/total; accumulator holds pointer/remaining; DAX wait pairs cache with aligned start; address holds tree/count/host; iterator holds pos/len, extents and bounds.

ABI: cant-mount marker under lock, link-count and delete notifications; temp buffers PATH_MAX; header placeholder one; core controls six entries under kernel ns with bounded ranges and read-only mode list.

DAX ABI: wait table twelve bits power-of-two; low four value bits flags shift four, locked/huge/zero/empty; huge colour/count from PMD/page ratio; trace marker; maximal signed end means file end; alloc/conflict report OOM, bus IO failure, fallback.
